cards.title: Career & Journey
cards.description: Cross-European scientific trajectory spanning Seville, Bonn/Cologne (Fraunhofer FHR cognitive radar), Marseille (MSc Plasma & Fusion Physics, 1st of Class), Pamplona (CENER wind plant data pipelines), and BSC Barcelona (HPC Fusion & Performance).

cards.title: Education & Skills
cards.description: BSc in Mathematics (8.28, 3rd of Class) & BSc in Physics (8.35, 3rd of Class), MSc Plasma Physics (1st of Class), Skills & Parallel HPC runtime stack, Slurm orchestration, After Effects, and deployment experience across MareNostrum 5 (MN5), Leonardo, and LUMI.

cards.title: Creative Computing
cards.description: Tangible data experiences bridging scientific computing with playful interaction: MNusic (real-time cluster telemetry sonification), Pipa-Music-Ball (cat-interactive 6-DoF kinetic sphere), Expo-Curator (open-source gallery staging engine), and Lens & Motion procedural animation.

cards.title: Cover Letter to DAV Group
cards.description: Strategic application statement addressed to the Data Analytics & Visualization Group at BSC-CNS: proposing to bridge petascale supercomputing with Domestic Data Streamers design philosophy to democratize science through emotional, tangible experiences.
